name: p5b_right_threshold_100
sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_cnt FROM orders o RIGHT JOIN customers c ON o.cust_id = c.id WHERE c.id <= 50 AND (o.amount > 100 OR o.amount IS NULL) GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY order_cnt DESC, c.id LIMIT 15

name: p5b_full_threshold_100
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(o.amount) FROM orders o FULL JOIN customers c ON o.cust_id = c.id WHERE o.amount < 100 OR o.amount IS NULL
